overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Capital Appreciation Market Opportunities ETF (TPUT) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on large cap equity. TPUT is designed to earn income by opportunistically investing in equity markets TPUT was launched on Jun 10, 2026 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
